proposals.title: Give Each Share an Equal Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a recapitalization plan giving all outstanding stock one vote per share via a phase-out eliminating Class B disproportionate voting rights.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding an Independent Chair
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, amending bylaws as necessary.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Facebook 2021 - Child Sexual Exploitation Online
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing risk of increased sexual exploitation of children as privacy tools such as end-to-end encryption are developed.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors believes that the preparation of the report contemplated by this proposal is unnecessary.

proposals.title: Human/Civil Rights Expert on Board
proposals.topic_summary: Requests nomination of at least one independent director candidate with high human and/or civil rights expertise.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors does not believe that setting aside a board seat for any predetermined profile is a good corporate governance practice

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Platform Misuse
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board report assessing benefits and drawbacks of maintaining enhanced 2020 election-cycle actions to reduce amplification of false and divisive information.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors believes that the preparation of the report contemplated by this proposal is unnecessary and not beneficial to our shareholders.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Public Benefit Corporation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests conversion to a public benefit corporation, contingent on converting Class B shares so at least 60% of voting power is not controlled by Mark Zuckerberg.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.
